The lock uses Bluetooth Low Energy for close-range control and a Wi-Fi bridge for remote access, so you can confirm that the door is locked while you are away. Up to 100 unique access codes can be created, each with a custom schedule, such as limiting a cleaner or contractor to specific weekday hours.

An auto-lock feature secures the door after a set interval, and an activity log records every lock and unlock event along with the method used. Fingerprint authentication is available on the optional touchscreen keypad model, and a built-in shake-to-wake sensor activates the keypad when you approach. A physical key override is included for emergencies, and the lock sounds an alert if the door is left ajar. Integration with smart home platforms enables routines that lock the door automatically at bedtime.

The exterior is finished in satin nickel over solid zinc alloy, with a stainless steel strike plate and a reinforced one-inch throw bolt that meets ANSI Grade 2 security standards. The internal mechanism uses hardened steel gears, and the battery compartment accepts four AA alkaline cells that the lock reports when they run low, typically lasting around twelve months under average use. The device operates reliably between minus 20 and 60 degrees Celsius and works with doors between 1.375 and 2.25 inches thick.

Care is minimal. Clean the keypad and body with a soft cloth dampened with water, and avoid harsh solvents that can damage the finish. Lubricate the latch annually with a silicone-based spray, and replace batteries before they fully drain. Ardent Lock Co provides a three-year limited warranty covering the lock mechanism and electronics, and free firmware updates for the life of the product. Installation instructions and a video guide are included in the box.

name: Haven Hub Smart Home Controller
description:
The Haven Hub is a central smart home controller that connects sensors, plugs, lights, locks, and cameras from different manufacturers into one coordinated system. It supports Zigbee 3.0, Z-Wave Plus, Thread, and Matter, which means most mainstream devices can be added without a separate bridge. Local processing keeps automations running during internet outages, and the hub stores scene and schedule data on its own internal memory rather than relying solely on a remote server.

A quad-core processor and 2 GB of RAM handle multiple automations simultaneously, such as turning on hallway lights when a door opens at night or sending a notification when a water leak sensor is triggered. The companion app features drag-and-drop routine building, energy usage graphs, and device grouping by room. Voice control works through compatible assistants, and the hub includes a built-in siren with a 95-decibel output that can be triggered by security sensors.

The hub measures 110 millimeters square and 32 millimeters tall, with a matte white polycarbonate shell and ventilation slots on the top surface. It draws power from a supplied 5-volt USB adapter and includes a 1000-milliamp-hour backup battery that maintains core functions for several hours during power loss. An Ethernet port provides a wired connection, and dual-band Wi-Fi offers a backup route. The unit is intended for indoor use between 0 and 40 degrees Celsius.

Keep the hub in an open location away from metal enclosures and thick masonry to preserve wireless range, and avoid placing it behind a television. Software updates are delivered automatically, and the device can be reset by holding the rear button for ten seconds. Nexora provides a two-year limited warranty on hardware and lifetime access to basic local control features. Extended support plans are available for businesses managing multiple properties.

name: Aegis Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Alarm
description:
The Aegis Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Alarm is a connected safety device that detects smoke and CO gas and sends immediate alerts to your smartphone, even when you are away from home. Its photoelectric sensing chamber responds quickly to smoldering fires, while an electrochemical CO sensor monitors levels continuously. A clear spoken warning identifies the hazard, such as smoke in the kitchen or dangerous carbon monoxide levels in the basement, helping occupants respond faster and with less confusion.

Each alarm can be linked wirelessly to others in the home through a mesh network, so when one unit sounds, every connected alarm sounds too. The companion app shows real-time air quality readings, sensor health status, and a history of past events. Nightlight functions and a hush feature allow you to silence nuisance alarms for up to ten minutes without disabling the detector. The unit also performs weekly self-tests and notifies you when the sensor requires replacement.

The housing is made from fire-resistant ABS plastic with a low-profile white finish that suits ceilings in hallways and bedrooms. It runs on a sealed 10-year lithium battery, so no battery changes are required during its service life. The device operates in temperatures from 0 to 40 degrees Celsius and mounts with included screws or adhesive pads. A tamper-resistant back plate and magnetic quick-release mount make removal and testing straightforward for property managers and landlords.

Test the alarm monthly by pressing the test button, and vacuum the vents gently every six months to remove dust that can interfere with sensing. Replace the entire unit after ten years, as sensors degrade over time, and keep the replacement date noted in the app. Veridian Safety provides a five-year limited warranty on the alarm and free over-the-air firmware updates. Meets applicable UL safety standards, and consult local regulations for proper placement and interconnected installation requirements.

name: Pulse Motion and Environment Sensor
description:
The Pulse Motion and Environment Sensor is a compact multipurpose device that detects movement, temperature, humidity, and ambient light in a single small package. It is well suited to hallways, closets, garages, and nurseries, where you want automatic lighting or a notification when a room is entered. The passive infrared sensor covers a 110-degree detection angle with a range of up to 25 feet, and the built-in light sensor allows automations to respond only when a room is dark.

The device connects through Zigbee and works with most major smart hubs, enabling routines that turn on lights, adjust thermostats, or trigger alerts. Temperature readings range from minus 10 to 50 degrees Celsius with an accuracy of plus or minus half a degree, and humidity is measured between 20 and 95 percent. Historical graphs in the companion app help identify drafts, damp spaces, or unusual temperature swings in a basement or attic.

The sensor measures 50 millimeters across and 30 millimeters deep, with a matte white ABS body and a magnetic mounting base that holds firmly on steel surfaces. Two included CR2450 coin cell batteries provide an estimated lifespan of up to two years under typical use, and the device reports low battery status through the app. Adhesive pads, screws, and a small wall bracket are included, allowing it to be mounted on ceilings, shelves, or door frames without tools.

To keep readings accurate, avoid placing the sensor directly beside heating vents, windows, or appliances that produce heat. Wipe the lens occasionally with a dry cloth, since dust can reduce motion detection accuracy. Tessel Home offers a one-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects and includes free replacement of faulty units during that period. Replacement batteries are widely available at most hardware and electronics retailers.

name: Volta Nest Smart Plug Mini 4-Pack
description:
The Volta Nest Smart Plug Mini 4-Pack gives you remote control and scheduling for lamps, fans, coffee makers, holiday lights, and other small appliances without replacing any hardware. Each plug fits into a standard wall outlet and works with a free companion app, allowing you to turn devices on or off from anywhere. Schedules, countdown timers, and randomized vacation modes help make an empty house appear occupied, which can deter opportunistic intruders while you travel.

Each unit includes energy monitoring that tracks real-time power consumption in watts and daily, weekly, and monthly totals. The app can estimate electricity costs based on your local rate, making it easier to identify energy-hungry devices. The plugs support 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and are compatible with popular voice assistants and smart home platforms. Group controls let you operate all plugs in a room with a single command, and routines can coordinate them with other devices in your home.

The compact housing is made from flame-retardant polycarbonate with a rated load of 15 amps at 125 volts, or roughly 1875 watts. Each plug features a built-in surge protection circuit and a child-safety shutter on the outlet face. The device is designed for indoor use between 0 and 40 degrees Celsius and avoids blocking adjacent outlets thanks to its slim profile. Plugs should not be used with space heaters or high-draw appliances that exceed their rated capacity.

To clean the plugs, unplug them first and wipe with a dry cloth; never use liquids on the outlet openings. If a plug fails to connect, press and hold the power button for ten seconds to reset it and rejoin your network. Volta Nest provides a two-year limited warranty on each plug and free app support. Replacement units can be purchased individually if one of the four pack becomes damaged.

name: Glacier Smart Thermostat
description:
The Glacier Smart Thermostat learns your household routine within its first week and adjusts heating and cooling automatically to reduce energy use without sacrificing comfort. Its occupancy sensing uses a combination of motion detection and smartphone location to determine when rooms are empty. The thermostat then shifts to an energy-saving setpoint, and it returns to your preferred temperature before you arrive. Monthly energy reports show how your usage compares with previous periods and suggest small changes that can lower bills.

The 3.5-inch color touchscreen displays weather forecasts, indoor humidity, and air quality readings from optional sensors placed in different rooms. Multi-zone support allows up to six sensors to balance temperature across floors, which is useful in homes with uneven airflow. The thermostat is compatible with most forced-air, heat pump, radiant, and dual-fuel systems, and it can operate with or without a common wire using an included power adapter. Voice control and smart home integrations are supported through a secure cloud connection.

The faceplate is constructed from tempered glass over a recycled polymer base and measures 84 millimeters in diameter. It mounts on a standard wall plate and includes a level indicator to simplify installation. Operating temperatures range from minus 20 to 50 degrees Celsius, and the device is rated for relative humidity up to 90 percent non-condensing. The internal sensor is factory calibrated, and an optional outdoor sensor can improve accuracy for homes with large temperature differences between sun and shade.

Keep the thermostat away from direct sunlight, drafts, and heat sources such as lamps or kitchen appliances, which can distort temperature readings. Clean the glass surface with a lightly dampened cloth and avoid harsh cleaners. Cirrus Climate offers a three-year limited warranty on the unit and a one-year warranty on included accessories. Professional installation services are available in most regions, and the company recommends having your HVAC system inspected annually.

name: Guardline Window and Door Sensor Kit
description:
The Guardline Window and Door Sensor Kit adds an extra layer of protection to entry points by alerting you the moment a door or window opens. The kit includes four slim contact sensors, each consisting of a magnet and a sensing unit that communicates wirelessly with your security system or smart hub. When the magnet separates from the sensor, the device sends a signal within a second, allowing you to respond quickly or trigger a siren and camera recording if the system is armed.

Each sensor can be assigned a custom name, such as back patio door or basement window, so notifications are clear and easy to understand. The sensors use a 915 MHz wireless protocol with a range of up to 300 feet in open areas, and the signal penetrates most interior walls. Sensors can be scheduled to ignore openings during set hours, such as when children return home from school, and bypass modes allow windows to remain open for ventilation without triggering alarms.

The housing is made from impact-resistant ABS plastic with a brushed silver finish that blends with most window frames and door trim. Each sensor is rated for indoor use between minus 10 and 50 degrees Celsius and uses a single replaceable CR2032 battery that is expected to last up to three years. Installation takes about fifteen minutes using the included adhesive backing or screws, and a maximum gap of half an inch between magnet and sensor is recommended for reliable detection.

Clean sensors with a dry cloth to remove dust that may collect around the magnet. Check mounting alignment after seasonal changes, since wood frames can expand or contract. Fortis Home provides a one-year limited warranty on the sensor kit and free replacement of defective units within that period. Replacement batteries and additional sensors are sold separately and can be added to your existing system at any time.

name: Grand Prix Road Tire 700x28c
description: The Continental Grand Prix Road Tire 700x28c is built for riders who want a fast, confident ride on pavement without sacrificing durability. Its tread uses a smooth, low-profile center section that minimizes rolling resistance, flanked by subtle grip zones that help maintain traction during hard cornering in wet conditions. A Vectran breaker layer sits beneath the tread, adding puncture resistance and reducing the chance of pinch flats from potholes and road debris. The casing uses a supple 330 thread-per-inch construction that improves comfort at higher pressures, and the bead is designed for a secure fit on most modern rims. Ideal use cases include daily commuting, long weekend group rides, sportive events, and fast training sessions on paved roads. Riders who regularly tackle gravel or unpaved paths should consider a wider tire, but for smooth asphalt the Grand Prix range offers an excellent balance of speed and security. The tire is tubeless-ready when paired with a compatible rim and sealant, which lets you run lower pressures for added grip and comfort. Installation is straightforward. Inflate gradually, check that the bead seats evenly, and never exceed the maximum pressure printed on the sidewall. Store tires away from direct sunlight, ozone sources, and solvents, as these accelerate rubber degradation. Clean the tread with mild soapy water rather than harsh chemicals, and inspect regularly for embedded glass, cuts, and uneven wear. Replace the tire when tread wear indicators appear or when the casing shows exposed threads. Materials include a silica-enhanced natural rubber compound for improved wet grip, a nylon casing, and Vectran breaker layers. The tire carries a one-year manufacturer warranty from the date of purchase covering manufacturing defects, but not damage from punctures, abrasion, or improper installation. Keep your receipt and original packaging for any warranty claim.

name: Eagle PC-1230 12-Speed Chain
description:
The SRAM Eagle PC-1230 12-Speed Chain is built for riders who expect their drivetrain to perform through steep climbs, muddy descents, and everything in between. Designed specifically for SRAM Eagle 12-speed drivetrains, it delivers smooth, quiet shifting and reliable power transfer across the full cassette range.

Key features include a precision-formed link geometry that engages cleanly with Eagle cassettes and chainrings, reducing skipping under load. Hardened steel pins and plates resist stretch and wear, helping maintain consistent shifting performance over the life of the chain. The chain is compatible with SRAM PowerLock connectors, allowing quick, tool-assisted installation and removal for routine maintenance or trail repairs.

Specifications:
- Speed: 12-speed
- Compatibility: SRAM Eagle 12-speed drivetrains
- Link count: 126 links
- Connector: SRAM PowerLock compatible

Materials: Steel construction with a durable surface finish that resists corrosion from water, mud, and road grime.

Intended use: Ideal for trail, enduro, and all-mountain mountain bikes, as well as aggressive cross-country setups. Riders running heavy-duty e-MTB systems should check manufacturer guidance for their specific application.

Care: Clean the chain regularly with a degreaser and a soft brush, then rinse and dry thoroughly. Apply a quality chain lubricant after cleaning and periodically wipe off excess to keep dirt from building up. Inspect for wear with a chain checker and replace the chain before it stretches enough to damage your cassette.

Warranty: Covered by SRAM's limited warranty against manufacturing defects when installed and maintained according to included instructions. Retain your proof of purchase and consult your authorized SRAM dealer for warranty claims.

name: PCS-10 Home Mechanic Repair Stand
description:
Turn your home garage into a proper workshop with the Park Tool PCS-10 Home Mechanic Repair Stand, a sturdy, portable workstand built for riders who want stable, professional-grade support without a dedicated bench. Whether you are truing a wheel, adjusting derailleurs, or completing a full tune-up, the PCS-10 holds your bike securely so both hands stay free for the work.

The stand is built around a durable steel tubular frame with a powder-coated finish that resists scratches and light corrosion. A quick-release clamp head grips the seat tube or top tube and rotates a full 360 degrees, so you can reposition the bike for easy access to the drivetrain, brakes, or wheels. The telescoping arm adjusts to a comfortable working height for riders of different sizes, and the folding tripod-style base stays planted on garage floors while folding flat for storage in a closet or trunk. A built-in tool tray keeps frequently used wrenches and tools within reach.

Specifications: Approximate weight of 16 pounds (7.3 kg). Adjustable working height. Clamp accommodates most standard bicycle frame tubes. Folding design with a compact stored footprint.

This stand suits routine maintenance such as brake and cable adjustments, drivetrain cleaning, flat tire repairs, and seasonal tune-ups. It works with road, mountain, hybrid, and cruiser frames, making it a practical choice for households with multiple bikes.

To keep the PCS-10 performing well, wipe down the frame after use, lightly lubricate the height adjustment and clamp threads, and store it indoors away from prolonged moisture. Periodically check that all bolts and clamp components remain snug.

The PCS-10 is covered by Park Tool's limited warranty against defects in materials and workmanship under normal home-shop use. Keep your proof of purchase and visit parktool.com for warranty terms and registration details.

name: Ergon GP5 Ergonomic Grips
description:
Designed for riders who spend long hours in the saddle, the Ergon GP5 Ergonomic Grips combine a sculpted profile with a secure lock-on fitment. The GP5 uses a contoured shape that supports the palm and distributes pressure across the heel of the hand, reducing numbness and fatigue on rough terrain and extended rides. A flared end cap provides a natural stop for your hand and a secure position when you shift weight forward on climbs or descents.

Each grip features a reinforced polyamide core for a firm, stable base, wrapped in a medium-density rubber compound that balances grip and cushioning in both wet and dry conditions. The surface is textured to enhance traction without abrading gloves. Integrated lock-on clamps tighten with included hex keys, eliminating the need for adhesive and allowing quick removal for cleaning or replacement.

Specifications:
- Length: 130 mm
- Diameter: 31.8 mm (fits 31.8 mm bar clamps)
- Weight: approx. 105 g per pair, excluding clamps
- Compatible with: mountain, trail, gravel, and hybrid handlebars with 22.2 mm or 31.8 mm lock-on clamp compatibility per model variant
- Colours: Black, Stealth Grey

Recommended for mountain biking, trail riding, gravel touring, and commuting. Compatible with most modern handlebars, including those with bar ends when the included spacer is used.

Care: Wipe grips with mild soapy water and a soft cloth after muddy rides. Avoid petroleum-based solvents, which can degrade rubber. Check lock-on clamp bolts regularly and retighten to the torque specified on the packaging.

Warranty: Ergon GP5 grips carry a two-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects. Normal wear, crash damage, and improper installation are not covered. Retain your proof of purchase for warranty claims.

name: Mini 20 Pro Multitool
description:
Keep your ride moving with the Topeak Mini 20 Pro Multitool, a compact all-in-one tool built for trail riders, commuters, and weekend mechanics who want reliable fixes without carrying a full toolbox. Packing 20 functions into a body roughly the size of a credit card, it covers the most common roadside adjustments and repairs.

The Mini 20 Pro features a full range of hex wrenches, including 2, 2.5, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 8 mm sizes, plus a T25 Torx driver, flat and Phillips screwdriver bits, and a chain breaker and rivet tool for quick chain repairs. A spoke key and tire lever are also included for emergency wheel and tire work. The bits are chrome vanadium steel, heat-treated for strength and hardness, and the tool body is machined from aluminum alloy that resists corrosion and holds up to repeated use. Each function folds neatly into the handle, so the tool stays flat, quiet, and easy to store in a saddle bag, jersey pocket, or pannier.

This multitool suits mountain biking, gravel riding, road cycling, and everyday commuting. Use it to tighten saddle clamps, handlebar stems, and brake levers, adjust derailleur limit screws, or shorten a chain after a mechanical failure. Its compact profile makes it well suited to trailside fixes, where a few extra grams of weight can matter.

To keep the tool in top condition, wipe it clean after wet or muddy rides and dry it thoroughly before storing. Periodically apply a light lubricant to the folding hinges to maintain smooth action, and inspect the chain tool pins for wear. Avoid using it as a pry bar or applying excessive torque beyond what the fastener requires.

The Mini 20 Pro is backed by Topeak's limited manufacturer warranty against defects in materials and workmanship under normal use. Retain your proof of purchase, and contact Topeak customer service for warranty claims or replacement parts.

name: Granit X-Plus 540 U-Lock
description:
The Abus Granit X-Plus 540 U-Lock is built for riders who park in busy cities, leave bikes outside overnight, or simply want the strongest protection they can carry. Its hardened steel shackle is 13 mm thick and resists cutting, prying, and leverage attacks, while the double-locking mechanism keeps the crossbar secure even when the lock is struck or manipulated. The shackle's internal dimensions of approximately 230 x 105 mm accommodate most frames, wheels, and fixed racks, though riders should measure against their typical locking points before purchase.

The lock body is made from high-grade hardened steel with a rugged powder-coated finish that resists scratches and light corrosion. Its ABUS Plus cylinder uses a patented, pick-resistant key profile, and the key cannot be copied without ABUS authorization. Each lock ships with two keys and a wall-mounted bracket that attaches securely to the frame or seat tube, keeping the lock out of the way during rides. At approximately 1.9 kg, it is heavier than cable locks, but it delivers the protection many urban cyclists need for high-value bikes and e-bikes.

For best results, lock the frame and rear wheel to an immovable object such as a bike rack or steel post, keeping the shackle as close to the ground as possible to limit leverage. Avoid locking through thin tubing or leaving gaps that would allow a tool to get inside.

To maintain performance, wipe the lock with a dry cloth after wet rides and apply a few drops of dry lubricant to the keyway every few months. Avoid oil-based products, which attract grit. Store the lock indoors where possible.

The Granit X-Plus 540 is covered by the manufacturer's limited warranty against defects in materials and workmanship. Retain your proof of purchase, and check your region's specific terms with your retailer or ABUS directly.

name: Seatpost Elite 27.2 mm Dropper
description:
Built for riders who want full control on steep, technical descents, the Thomson Seatpost Elite 27.2 mm Dropper lets you lower your saddle out of the way in an instant and return it to full height with a flick of the lever. Thomson's proven cable-actuated design keeps the action smooth and predictable, so you can shift your weight and body position without stopping.

The internal cartridge uses a sealed, low-friction air-spring system that delivers consistent return force ride after ride. A remote lever mounts to standard handlebar clamp positions, and the compact actuator keeps your cockpit uncluttered. Internal cable routing reduces snag points and protects the cable from trail debris.

Key specifications include a 27.2 mm seatpost diameter, a 350 mm overall length with travel options to suit a range of frame sizes, and a maximum insertion depth clearly marked on the post. The seatpost is compatible with most standard 27.2 mm seat tube inside diameters, and the included shims help ensure a secure fit.

The post body is machined from 6061 aluminum alloy for a strong, lightweight build, while the stanchions and hardware use corrosion-resistant stainless steel. Anodized finishes resist scratches and wear from repeated mud, grit, and rain exposure.

This dropper is ideal for trail riding, enduro, and all-mountain disciplines, where quick saddle changes make a noticeable difference on sustained descents and tight switchbacks. It is also a practical upgrade for gravity-focused riders who want to improve body position and confidence on rough terrain.

To maintain performance, wipe the post after muddy rides, keep the seal area clean, and avoid high-pressure washing near the seals. Lubricate the cable periodically and have the cartridge serviced according to the manufacturer's guidelines. This Thomson product is covered by a limited warranty against defects in materials and workmanship under normal use.

name: Resin Disc Brake Pads
description:
Shimano Resin Disc Brake Pads are precision-engineered replacements designed to restore consistent, quiet stopping power on your bike. Formulated with a resin-based friction compound, these pads deliver smooth modulation from the first moment of lever pull, making them a reliable choice for trail, cross-country, and everyday riding.

Resin compounds are prized for their progressive feel and low rotor wear. They bed in quickly, perform well in dry and mixed conditions, and produce less noise than many sintered alternatives. Each pad features a steel backing plate with cooling fins that help dissipate heat during extended descents, and a wear indicator groove that tells you clearly when replacement is due.

Shimano manufactures these pads to exacting tolerances, ensuring accurate fitment and clean alignment within compatible calipers. The friction surface is designed to minimize glazing and maintain a stable bite over thousands of kilometers when properly maintained.

Specifications
Compound: Resin
Backing plate: Steel with heat-dissipating fins
Compatibility: Shimano hydraulic disc brake calipers (see fitment chart)
Set contents: One pair (two pads)
Wear indicator: Integrated groove

Recommended use
These pads suit mountain biking, gravel riding, touring, and urban commuting. In heavy mud or prolonged wet conditions, riders may notice faster wear compared to metallic compounds, so inspect pads regularly after rides in these conditions.

Care and maintenance
Avoid touching the friction surface with bare hands, as skin oils reduce braking performance. Clean rotors with isopropyl alcohol before installation. After installing new pads, perform 15 to 20 firm stops from moderate speed to bed them in. Replace pads once the wear groove disappears.

Warranty
Shimano Resin Disc Brake Pads carry a one-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects when purchased from an authorized dealer. Normal wear is not covered. Retain your proof of purchase and contact Shimano customer support for warranty claims.

name: Ion Pro RT Rear Light
description:
Stay visible on every ride with the Bontrager Ion Pro RT Rear Light, a USB rechargeable taillight built for commuters, training riders, and anyone sharing the road after dark. Its bright, wide-angle LED array sits inside a sleek, aerodynamic housing that mounts quickly and holds firm over rough pavement and gravel.

Multiple lighting modes include steady and flashing patterns designed to catch drivers' attention in traffic, and a battery level indicator shows remaining runtime at a glance. Output reaches up to 80 lumens on the brightest setting, while lower modes extend battery life on longer rides. The rubberized power button is easy to press with gloves on.
